direct.title: Receive Growatt readings in Home Assistant
direct.description: Home Assistant will listen for your ShineWiFi dataloggers on this port. Point each datalogger at this Home Assistant host and port. Cloud forwarding keeps Growatt's cloud service available and falls back to local replies if it fails. The default profile selects a layout from each packet. Stop any other receiver using this port first.

modbus.title: Read a Growatt inverter over Modbus TCP
modbus.description: Use this only if your inverter or gateway exposes direct Modbus TCP. A ShineWiFi upload connection alone does not establish that it does. Choose a documented profile for normal readings; the raw investigation fields are ignored for those profiles. Investigate raw reads one selected block only, creates disabled diagnostic entities and never saves raw values for restart recovery. Raw words may contain identifiers or settings; keep them private. All requests are paced and read-only.

companion.title: Connect the HA Growatt companion
companion.description: {connection_note} Keep the HA Growatt app and MQTT running. This companion adds repair notices and buffered-reading events using your existing MQTT connection. It creates no duplicate measurement sensors. Daylight checks use Home Assistant's location and allow two minutes after startup.

abort.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration and start the HA Growatt app first.

error.port_in_use: Home Assistant cannot open that port. Stop the other receiver or choose another port.

receiver.title: HA Growatt readings and controls
receiver.description: Missing readings wait until daylight and the sunrise grace period. Changing the native receiver's family waits for fresh readings before restoring saved values. Controls start disabled; a connected inverter must answer a setting read before a control appears. Experimental battery settings need matching hardware and separate authorisation here. Optional unknown-packet diagnostics show packet shapes and counts, never raw values or serials.

data.forward_cloud: Forward to Growatt cloud (native receiver only)

modbus_options.title: Direct Modbus readings
modbus_options.description: Changing the connection or register profile leaves the current entity IDs in place. A documented profile needs a complete valid reading before values update; raw investigation fields are ignored for those profiles. Investigate raw reads one selected block; its diagnostic entities are disabled by default and raw values are not saved for restart recovery. Raw words may contain identifiers or settings. This route never writes registers or forwards data to Growatt.

data.daylight_alerts: Warn about failed reads during daylight

inverter.title: Choose an inverter
inverter.description: Choose a discovered inverter to set its control profile. The physical model label is more reliable than a packet layout.

inverter_model.title: Control profile for {inverter}
inverter_model.description: Enter the exact model from the inverter's physical label. This does not prove that a write is safe or that a battery is installed. Leave the control profile on Automatic unless a documented family matches. Experimental battery controls also need their separate switch enabled and successful setting readback.

http_output.title: HTTP output
http_output.description: Send each live reading to an HTTP or HTTPS endpoint using the app's JSON message format. Clear the address to turn this output off.

pvoutput_output.title: PVOutput
pvoutput_output.description: Enter your system ID and API key. Leave the key blank to keep its saved value; clear the system ID to turn this output off. Buffered readings are skipped.

influx_output.title: InfluxDB
influx_output.description: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS endpoint. Leave the token or password blank to keep its saved value; clear the endpoint to turn this output off. Buffered readings are skipped.

mqtt_output.title: Raw MQTT
mqtt_output.description: Send app-compatible JSON readings to a separate MQTT topic. This is optional and does not create Home Assistant discovery entities. Leave the password blank to keep its saved value; clear the host to turn this output off.

abort.no_inverters: Wait for a fresh inverter reading before choosing its control profile.

error.port_in_use: Home Assistant cannot open that port. Stop the other receiver or choose another port.
error.api_key_required: Enter a PVOutput API key to enable this output.
error.invalid_output: Check the address and required settings for this destination.

service_offline.title: HA Growatt is not reporting its status
service_offline.description: Check that the HA Growatt app and MQTT broker are running if you use the app route. The app has reported that it is offline, or its status is missing during daylight after the sunrise grace period. Missing status alone does not raise a warning overnight. Saved readings remain visible and may be old. This warning clears when current status messages resume.

decode_failed.title: HA Growatt cannot decode the incoming measurements
decode_failed.description: Check the inverter family in integration options or the app's reading profile. Download diagnostics and a shareable packet report if the model is not recognised. New session-key encrypted dataloggers need additional protocol support; changing profiles does not decrypt them.

feed_stale.title: A Growatt inverter is silent during daylight
feed_stale.description: Inverter {inverter} has sent no fresh reading for at least {minutes} minutes. Check its power, datalogger connection and selected reading profile. Normal overnight silence is excluded, with a grace period after sunrise. The warning clears when fresh readings arrive or night begins.

modbus_unavailable.title: HA Growatt cannot read the Modbus gateway
modbus_unavailable.description: The configured direct Modbus TCP connection has not returned a complete reading during daylight. Check the gateway address, unit number, selected register profile and whether the inverter is awake. The ShineWiFi upload address is a separate connection. No register writes have been sent.
